description: Cac cap dieu kien logic (bieu thuc boolean) trich xuat tu module AUTH va ACCESS CONTROL cua he thong SecureSys. Muc tieu: kiem chung xem phien ban 'toi uu hoa' (thuong do lap trinh vien viet lai de 'cho gon' hoac 'toi uu hieu nang') co TUONG DUONG LOGIC voi phien ban goc hay khong. Day la ung dung kinh dien cua SMT solving trong kiem chung phan mem (Chuong 3: 3.1-3.4).

variables.note: Moi bien la boolean (kieu bool) hoac so nguyen (kieu int), duoc khai bao rieng cho tung cap dieu kien trong truong 'var_types'.

condition_pairs.context: Dieu kien mo khoa cua (module Access Control, tuong ung P1 Lab1)
condition_pairs.note: Ap dung luat De Morgan: NOT(NOT a OR NOT b) == a AND b -> tuong duong.

condition_pairs.context: Dieu kien khoa tai khoan (module Auth, tuong ung Lab2 validate_pin)
condition_pairs.note: LOI OFF-BY-ONE kinh dien: '>= 3' va '> 3' KHONG tuong duong tai failed_attempts == 3 (mo hop le o ban toi uu nhung phai khoa theo dac ta).

condition_pairs.context: Dieu kien PIN hop le ve mat do dai va chu so (Lab2, don gian hoa)
condition_pairs.note: Phep AND co tinh giao hoan va ket hop -> doi thu tu / nhom lai khong lam thay doi ket qua.

condition_pairs.context: Dieu kien canh bao an toan tai trang thai (tuong ung thuoc tinh P2 Lab1)
condition_pairs.note: a -> b tuong duong (NOT a) OR (b AND a) trong logic co dien (co the kiem chung bang bang chan tri hoac SMT).

condition_pairs.context: Dieu kien bo qua xac thuc sai lech (loi bao mat tiem an, module Auth)
condition_pairs.note: Ban 'toi uu' THEM mot duong bypass cho admin -> KHONG tuong duong, day chinh la mot 'backdoor' tiem an can bi tu choi khi review code.

condition_pairs.context: Dieu kien gioi han so luong sach muon toi da (module Inventory/Order, Lab7)
condition_pairs.note: a <= b tuong duong NOT(a > b) tren mien so nguyen -> tuong duong logic.
